description_zh: Cruise AV 在路口准备左转时，右侧相邻车道的 BMW 变道切入，与 AV 右后角发生碰撞。选用 cut_in 原语表达变道冲突。

source_snippets: A Cruise autonomous vehicle (“Cruise AV”), operating in autonomous mode, was waiting for oncoming traffic to clear the intersection before making a left turn onto Bush Street from southbound Steiner Street when another vehicle made contact with the right rear corner of the Cruise AV
VEH 2 MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: J. CHANGING LANES
evidence.reason: 事故涉及两辆移动车辆，Cruise AV 左转，BMW 变道切入，属于可表达的双方交互碰撞。选用 cut_in block 和 adjacent position 表达。
